statements.statement: The patient presented with recurrent, intermittent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
These episodes were difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring
The patient has a documented history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a documented history of supraventricular tachycardia
CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous ECG monitoring) was billed
Diagnosis codes I47.1, I48.0, and I49.9 were submitted
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
